Looking for a Los Angeles foreign language interpreter you can trust with your translation needs?

How to Use a Foreign Language Interpreter in Los Angeles CA?

To use our services is easy.

Start by emailing our local office and providing us with the following information:

  • Your contact info (name, phone number, email, etc.)
  • The type of service you’re looking for
  • The time and date you prefer
  • Number of translators
  • Skill level of translators

Once our Los Angeles language interpreter agency receives this information, we can provide you with a quote. When we receive payment, we’ll schedule a time and date based on your preferences. All interpretation services are backed by our guarantee, so if the interpretation is unsuccessful, we’ll refund your money.

Why Hire Our Los Angeles Language Interpreter Agency

There are many reasons for hiring a Los Angeles foreign language interpreter through our agency. Here is what you can expect.

  • Member of the ATA since 2009
  • 15 years of hands-on experience
  • Well-trained and highly educated employees
  • Over 100 languages spoken
  • Fast, flexible appointments
  • On-site and telephone interpretations

How to Schedule Service with AET Los Angeles

Don’t trust just any interpretation service with your translation needs. It’s important that the interpreter understands the language, as well as its dialect. You can expect this level of quality from one of our foreign language interpreters in Los Angeles CA - we process thousands of translations every year!

To schedule an appointment with our Los Angeles foreign language interpreter, send us an email today with your information and we’ll get back to you right away.
